info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Assigns-v1-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Assignment API allows users to efficiently retrieve a list of support tickets assigned to specific agents or teams. This endpoint serves as a vital resource for customer support departments seeking to manage and track assignments effectively. Typical consumers include support managers and team leads aiming to monitor ticket workloads, improve response times, and enhance customer satisfaction. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their support workflows and ensure accountability within their teams.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch assignment information related to tickets. It provides insights into which users are assigned to specific tickets, facilitating better tracking and management of tasks associated with those tickets.

requestBody.description: This request body is required to assign a ticket to a user. It contains the necessary information for the operation, ensuring the correct processing of ticket assignments.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the assign operation related to tickets. It is expected to be a string format.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsResponse_202.title: Ticket Assignment Response

status.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the ticket assignment.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the ticket assignment operation.

state.description: Current state of the ticket after assignment.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the assignment in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the ticket assignment.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsResponse_202.description: Response schema for the ticket assignment operation indicating the result of the assignment process.

Audit.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the ticket assignment was performed automatically.

Audit.description: Details about the auditing of the ticket assignment process.

schema.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
